title: The agent's ask_user_question opens the Questions tab in the right pane with the whole set, a PointerCard replaces dsh's one-question card, Ask me follow-up questions makes the agent ask a new set, and the tab-questions switch off brings dsh's card back
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), COOKIE_DOMAIN, PG, WEB, DSH, Q, api. STAND_DIR = the ~/TCH-local/<name> folder whose .env has TRACY_ORIGIN equal to O (askform stand: O=http://askform.tracy.test:38080, STAND_DIR=~/TCH-local/askform, DSH=tracy-askform-dsh, PG=tracy-askform-postgres-1). Mint two cookies with that .env's SESSION_SECRET: A = an owner seat of a WordPress site S on the stand (askform: ask-form-e2e@example.test, S=askwp1.askform.tracy.test, label askwp1), ADMIN = a seat with an accepted role in the workspace kind='tracy_admin' (askform: ask-form-admin@example.test). Find them read-only: pq "select a.email, s.site_key, s.role from seat s join account a on a.id=s.account_id where s.revoked_at is null" and pq "select a.email from seat_workspace sw join workspace w on w.id=sw.workspace_id join account a on a.id=sw.account_id where w.kind='tracy_admin' and sw.accepted_at is not null and sw.revoked_at is null". No such seats → BLOCKED note no-seats.

Build check: docker exec $DSH grep -c 'tracy:ask-user' /desk-home/profiles/native/node_modules/@tracy/dsh-ask-form/lib/client.js must print >= 1, and docker exec $DSH sh -c "grep -rl 'asked for follow-up questions before deciding' /opt/dsh/packages/interaction/tool-ask-user/lib/ | head -1" must print a path; otherwise BLOCKED note image-without-ask-form.

Switch on first: api with the ADMIN cookie PUT /api/ops/ui '{"switches":{"tab-questions":true}}' (header Origin: O, as api() sends) -> 200; then GET /api/ui with cookie A -> record HIDDEN_ON = whether the hidden array contains 'tab-questions'.

Browser (README rules: connectOverCDP, NEW context with cookie A on COOKIE_DOMAIN, never close anything). Use a chrome-watch of this stand's own, not the shared :9222 one: run CHROME_WATCH_PORT=9380 chrome-watch (it reuses one already listening there) and connectOverCDP('http://127.0.0.1:9380'). The shared :9222 Chrome holds other sessions' stuck pages and connectOverCDP can hang there for its whole timeout (this case's first run, 04/10, then numbered REG-061, later REG-066: BLOCKED on exactly that); if :9380 hangs too (60 s), try one more free port (9381) the same way before BLOCKED. The stand's image may be built from an ancestor commit of the one under test when only tests/ and tasks/ differ; that is not a reason to block. page.goto(O + '/' + S); wait (<= 90 s) for a URL containing /s/session- and [data-composer-input='true'], then wait until page.url() has not changed for 15 s (the landing redirects once more, to ?open=browser…, a few seconds after the first session URL; pressing New session before that lands the page on another session than the one the message goes to — this case's second run, 04/10, FAIL on exactly that). Press the button whose aria-label is exactly 'New session', wait (<= 30 s) for a new /s/session- URL and again until it has not changed for 15 s; record SESSION = the session-<uuid> part of the URL.

Send in the composer (README 'Send a chat message' recipe): 'Tao muốn bán file PDF trả phí ở mục Resources. Làm giúp tao.' Then every 30 s for up to 8 minutes check for [data-ask-form='dsh']. Every check, also find the session that holds the sent message (the newest folder under /desk-home/sessions/--site-<label>--/ whose decoded file — decoding step below — has that text in an agent/inbox/spliced event) is the one under test — if it differs from the session in page.url(), set SESSION to it, record SESSION_MOVED = true and page.goto(O + '/' + S + '/s/' + SESSION) before reading the page again. The model may read the site for 1-3 minutes before asking; do not open another session early. If after 8 minutes there is no [data-ask-form] and the decoded session file (next step) has a turn/end with no ask_user_question tool/call, start ONE more new session and send 'I want to sell paid PDF downloads in the Resources section. Before you build anything, ask me how customers should pay and anything else you need, using your question tool.'; still nothing → FAIL note agent-never-asked (record the reply text).

When [data-ask-form='dsh'] appears, wait 3 s and record: TAB_ACTIVE = whether an element [role=tab][aria-selected='true'] has text 'Questions'; ITEMS1 = the data-ask-item attribute of every [data-ask-form='dsh'] [data-ask-item]; POINTER = innerText of [data-tracy-ask-pointer] (or null); DSH_CARD = whether dsh's own question card is in the page: an element [data-question-key] (the frame of dsh's QuestionComposer, vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness packages/client/ui-user-questions/src/client/QuestionComposer.tsx) that is not inside [data-ask-form] — read on the live page with document.querySelectorAll, never on a cloned node (a detached clone has no layout, so its innerText is its textContent and the words around dsh's '1 / 3' counter run together: the third run read false from that while the screenshot showed the card). Screenshot to $Q.

Decode the session file: docker exec $DSH cat /desk-home/sessions/--site-<label>--/SESSION/session.v4.jsonl.zstd > $Q/s.zst; the file holds several zstd frames, so split it on the magic bytes 28 b5 2f fd and run node's zlib.zstdDecompressSync on each part, joining the text; each line is one JSON event. Record CALL1 = the callId and the question ids of the first event with type 'tool/call' and data.name 'ask_user_question'.

Without choosing anything, press the button 'Ask me follow-up questions'. Then every 20 s for up to 6 minutes re-decode the session file. Record R1 = the text of every tool/result whose data.message.toolCallId is CALL1's callId; record CALL2 = the first later 'tool/call' named 'ask_user_question' (callId and question ids, and the question texts), or null if a turn/end came first. If CALL2 exists, wait (<= 60 s) for [data-ask-form='dsh'] again and record ITEMS2 the same way as ITEMS1.

Switch off: api with ADMIN PUT /api/ops/ui '{"switches":{"tab-questions":false}}' -> record PUT_OFF status; GET /api/ui with cookie A -> HIDDEN_OFF = whether hidden contains 'tab-questions'. page.goto(O + '/' + S + '/s/' + SESSION) (no query string); wait (<= 90 s) for [data-composer-input] or a textarea in the composer area, then 8 s more. Record OFF_POINTER = whether [data-tracy-ask-pointer] exists, OFF_FORM = whether [data-ask-form='dsh'] exists, OFF_DSH_CARD = the DSH_CARD test again. Screenshot to $Q.

Always restore, even after a failure above: api with ADMIN PUT /api/ops/ui '{"switches":{"tab-questions":true}}' -> record PUT_BACK; GET /api/ui with cookie A -> HIDDEN_BACK. If the session still waits on a question, press 'Decide for me' in the Questions tab (re-open it from the PointerCard's Open button after a reload) so the session does not stay blocked; this press is not judged.
expect: The build check prints a count >= 1 and a path.
TAB_ACTIVE === true and ITEMS1 lists every question id of CALL1 (the whole set, not one at a time).
POINTER matches /question(s)? (is|are) waiting in the right pane/ and DSH_CARD === false (dsh's one-question card is not in the chat column while the form holds the request).

R1 has exactly one entry; it parses (up to its first newline) as JSON with action 'follow_up', and it contains the line 'The customer asked for follow-up questions before deciding; ask only what is new, do not repeat answered questions.'
CALL2 is not null, its callId differs from CALL1's, and its set of question ids is not equal to CALL1's (the agent asked a new set instead of repeating the same one).
ITEMS2 equals CALL2's question ids (the tab opened again with the new set).
PUT_OFF is 200, HIDDEN_OFF === true, OFF_POINTER === false, OFF_FORM === false and OFF_DSH_CARD === true (dsh's own card asks again).
Model-dependent: if the agent never asks, or answers the follow-up press in plain text with no new ask_user_question call, the verdict is FAIL with the reply text quoted — never PASS.

selectors.buttons: 'Send answer' / 'Decide for me' / 'Ask me follow-up questions' (packages/ui/tracy-ask-form/src/client/strings.ts)

evidence: tasks/evidence/ask-form/README.md (stand askform, 04/10/2026): three sessions on askwp1 — Send answer, Decide for me, Ask me follow-up questions — and the switch turned off and on.
fence: The composer chain entry at priority -10 that is registered only while tab-questions is on, the tab opened once per pending request, and the fork's tool result carrying action plus the follow-up line the model reads. Not judged: what the agent builds after the answers.
